recipes.title: Flourless Egg-White Cinnamon Rolls (No Sugar)
steps: Whip the egg whites with the salt to stiff peaks, then beat in the erythritol and vanilla.
Spread on a baking tray lined with baking paper in a thin, even rectangle and dust generously with cinnamon.
Bake at 180°C (350°F) for 8–10 minutes until set and lightly golden. Let it cool a little.
Mix the cream cheese, yogurt, vanilla and stevia until smooth and spread over the sheet.
Roll up gently using the paper, then slice into 5 rolls.
recipes.notes: Translated from the creator's Spanish post. She gives 260 kcal and 25 g protein for the whole batch, about 52 kcal and 5–5.6 g protein per roll. Only the bake time is written; the method is from the video, and carbs and fat are my estimates (erythritol not counted).
